answer_1.quote: We propose LITE, a framework for training todo task representation models using the following auxiliary tasks: (1) autocompletion of to-do descriptions, (2) pre-action and goal generation based on COMET, and (3) action attribute predictions based on FrameNet.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates maximal forms of to-do descriptions (autocompletion), prerequisite and goal actions for a given to-do item (pre-action and goal generation), and predicts action arguments associated with the to-do task (action arguments prediction).
